_doc: ACTUAL historical release dates (evidence) for backfill placement. Built by tools/econ/build_release_history.py from saved agency pages (sources below, sha256). Row = [release_date_ET, time_ET|null, precision, source]. null time = date only -> placed at the end of that ET day. See docs/economic-data/BACKFILL-TIMING.md.

bls_hist_pdf.note: pdftotext -layout of the PDF; PDF sha256 in bls_histreleasedates.pdf

bls_lapse_notice.note: bls:empsit 2025-10: Oct 2025 establishment data published with Nov 2025; bls:jolts 2025-09: Sep 2025 JOLTS cancelled, published with Oct 2025; bls:ppi 2025-10: Oct 2025 PPI published with Nov 2025

fed_g17.url: https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g17/default.htm (fetched 2026-09-29); every release states 'For release at 9:15 a.m.'

census_listview.url: https://www.census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (Wayback captures 2014-2026; rows kept only when released on/before the capture)

fed_statcalendar.note: times only: a row is 'exact' when statcalendar lists that same date for the release

fed_h8_archive.note: mapping: archived releases 1996-06-14, 2001-01-05, 2008-01-04, 2015-01-02, 2026-09-25 each carry the Wednesday 9 days earlier as their latest week (H.8 page: released Friday, Thursday when Friday is a holiday)

fed_h41_archive.note: mapping: H.4.1 page: 'released each Thursday' for the week ended Wednesday (the Wednesday level)

fed_h10_archive.note: mapping: H.10 page: 'On Mondays ... releases daily ... for the previous business week'; the following business day when Monday is a holiday

fed_g19_archive.note: mapping: archived releases 1996-12-06 (Oct 1996), 2000-06-07 (Apr), 2008-10-07 (Aug), 2013-10-07 (Aug), 2025-10-07 (Aug), 2025-11-07 (Sep), 2026-09-08 (Jul): the second month before the release month

fed_h6_archive.note: mapping: monthly release since 2021-02-23 (4th Tuesday) carries the previous month; the weekly era is NOT mapped (the archive does not say which weekly release first carried a month)
